purpose: Teach: ウニ/髭/洋書/つば/にんにく/マヨネーズ/ヤギ/泡盛

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、お寿司でウニ頼んだろ?
lines.en: So you ordered uni at the sushi place, right?
lines.style: Light, playful accusation. Casual, testing — like she's caught him in something small and harmless. Quick rhythm, slight smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、髭生えてきたな、桜
lines.en: Since when are you growing a beard, Sakura?
lines.style: Dry deflection. Throws the attention back at her without heat. Low, almost amused — the kind of comeback that buys him a second to think.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、英語の授業で洋書読まされてんだろ?
lines.en: Didn't they make you read English novels in class?
lines.style: Persistent but not annoyed. Leaning into the game — she knows he's dodging and she's okay with it. Slight rhythm change, more direct than before.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、しゃべる時、つば飛ばすなよ、桜
lines.en: Don't spit when you talk, Sakura.
lines.style: Flat, deadpan complaint. No malice — just the tired observation of someone who's been on the receiving end. Slight uptick at the end like he's actually concerned.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、給食のにんにく料理の臭い気にしてんだろ?
lines.en: You're worried about the garlic smell from lunch, aren't you?
lines.style: Continues the accusation rhythm. Knowingly prodding at something he noticed. Lighter now — she's enjoying this more than he is.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、サラダにマヨネーズかけ過ぎだろ、桜
lines.en: You put way too much mayo on your salad, Sakura.
lines.style: Flat observation that somehow carries weight. Not a lecture — just stating what he sees. Slight pause before her name, like he's shaking his head at the absurdity.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、動物園のヤギ好きだろ?
lines.en: You really like those goats at the zoo, don't you?
lines.style: Lighter touch now. The teasing has worn into something almost fond. Slower pace — he's genuinely curious about why she cares about this.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、泡盛は大人になってからな、桜
lines.en: You can have awamori when you're older, Sakura.
lines.style: Gentle redirect with a hint of parental care underneath. Protective without lecturing. Quiet but firm — drawing a line he actually means.
